description:
Rooney Auctioneers are delighted present to the market this excellently located home in the popular Woodhaven development. Castletroy is one of Limericks most desirable residential areas as it is within walking distance of an array of super amenities including the University of Limerick, Castletroy College, local national schools, Castletroy Shopping Centre, Castletroy Golf Club and many more. 71 Dromroe Avenue is a well-presented mid-terraced house situated in a desirable residential setting and benefits from a private garden, providing a pleasant outdoor space for residents to enjoy. The property also benefits from solar panels and an electric car charging point, offering excellent modern energy-efficient features and added convenience for the future homeowner.
The accommodation consists of 3 bedrooms one of which is ensuite, living room, kitchen-diner, bathroom and wc. Viewing is highly recommended. Approx. size 96 sq/m (1,044 sq/ft). Contact Julia Kearney.

Features:
Super location walking distance to all amenities
M7/M20/M18 motorway network is easily accessible
In excellent condition throughout
The property also benefits from solar panels and an electric car charging point
Front driveway with parking 
Beautiful garden patio and shed
Built in wardrobes to all bedrooms
Brand new gas boiler
Gas fired central heating, double glazed pvc windows
Appliances included in sale.

Entrance hall -  4.28 x 1.83 Tiled floor, carpeted stairs and landing, guest wc off.
Living room - 3.39 x 5.56. Laminated floor, electric fire, bay window, double doors into kitchen-diner.
Kitchen-Diner - 5.32 x 4.10. Fitted kitchen with electric oven hob & extractor, washing machine, dishwasher, patio doors to rear garden.
Upstairs:
Bedroom 1 - 2.98 x 3.90. Double bedroom with built in wardrobe, laminate floor, ensuite.
Ensuite - 1.90 x 1.92. Fully tiled, wc whb, electric shower.
Bedroom 2 - 3.05 x 3.40. Double bedroom with built in wardrobe, laminate floor.
Bedroom 3 - 3.33 x 2.23. Large single room with laminate floor and built in wardrobe.
Bathroom - 2.26 x 1.73. Fully tiled, wc whb, bath with electric shower.
